notes:
Summary: Mid-market adtech platform focused on per-impression reranking and RTB decisioning. Very latency- and cost-sensitive; we are the shortlisted infra vendor for inference.

Key requirements:
- Workloads: reranking for auctions (primary), user-level personalization scoring (secondary). Low token counts per request (short prompts + features).
- Latency: target end-to-end p95 < 40ms, p99 < 120ms for single-shot rerank calls under production mix.
- Throughput: sustained 4k-6k qps peak during campaign spikes; burst capacity for 15k qps windows.
- Cost: tight cost-per-request targets; wants to reduce per-inference spend by >=30% vs current baseline.
- Model preferences: open Llama-derivative or quantized GPT-like smaller models; willing to accept 8-bit/4-bit if quality holds for CTR/rerank metric.
- Routing/fallback: need multi-tier fallback (quantized variant -> region fallback -> lower-cost model) with deterministic degradation.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS for keys, EU data residency for some clients.

POC scope (agreed):
- 72h perf run of their 3 sample campaigns (traffic replay) using: baseline FP16, 8-bit dynamic-quant, and 4-bit quant profiles.
- Test batching strategies: request-level micro-batching vs affinity-based batching; evaluate latency tail and cost per request.
- KV/prefix caching experiment for repeated auction contexts (expected ~18% token savings).
- Failure/fallback exercise: simulated GPU pressure to validate automatic fallback to compatible model variants.
- Deliverable: side-by-side perf matrix (latency percentiles, tokens/sec, cost per 1M requests) + quality delta on CTR proxy metric.

Recent timeline (shorthand):
- 2026-02-12: Intro demo (Marco, Priya, Eng lead Ana K.) — positive.
- 2026-02-20: Shared traffic replay + baseline metrics (IronClave).
- 2026-03-01: Technical deep-dive — asked for quantization accuracy tests; provided sample eval set. (ff_20260301_ironclave_poc)
- 2026-03-04: Security intake questionnaire submitted; they requested SOC2 & key rotation details. (gt_security_review_20260120)

Quotes from AE notes: "If we can hit p95 under 40ms with a 25-30% cost reduction, this is a go — but security must sign off."

Open questions / risks:
- How does 4-bit quantization affect our rerank model ranking quality? Need clear thresholds (AUC/CTR delta).
- Autoscaling burst behavior and cold-starts during rapid campaign spikes — need deterministic warm pools.
- E2E latency includes network hop to VPC endpoint; need joint validation with their infra team.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood: provision dedicated POC env (vpc) + quant profiles; schedule perf run 2026-03-07 -> 2026-03-09.
- IronClave: provide final traffic replay, evaluation scripts, and the CTR proxy metric spec by 2026-03-06.
- Security: schedule SOC2 architecture review meeting w/ security lead (tentative 2026-03-08).

Stubs/refs: pricing deck (drive/ironclave/poc-plan-v2.pdf), benchmarking template (drive/ironclave/latency-benchmarking-results.xlsx), Jira escalation INF-4312 (request for custom batching hook).
